changelog.notes: First version. Geometry copied from the field-of-regard simulator; OH calibration not yet known.
OH is measured in the A-X (1-0) band at ~282 nm (John Noonan), inside the nominal bandpass. Added oh_bands; the OH flux factor and g-factor refer to (1-0) only.

pixel_scale.source: Plate-scale audit 2026-11-18; confirm against the flight WCS

observer_site.source: ultrasat_object_search.api_query; replace with a Horizons spacecraft ID once one exists

bandpass.source: Public mission description (Shvartzvald et al. 2024); needs the measured throughput curve. Contains OH A-X (1-0) at ~282 nm; check the red edge for leakage from (0-0) at 309 nm and (1-1) at 314 nm.

throughput_curve.source: Effective area vs wavelength, needed to compute beta and the OH flux factor

oh_bands.source: Planned ULTRASAT method uses the OH A-X (1-0) transition at ~282 nm, analogous to Swift's use of (0-0) in UVW1 (John Noonan, 2026-11-18). The g-factor is the (1-0) column of Schleicher & A'Hearn 1988 Table 5.

oh_band.source: Filter name (FITS FILTER keyword) of the band used for OH

continuum_band.source: Filter name of the dust continuum band, or the method used if ULTRASAT has a single band

beta.source: Continuum scale: OH-band count rate per continuum-band count rate for solar-colour dust (solar spectrum through the ULTRASAT throughput, as swift_comet_pipeline does for UVW1/V)

oh_flux_per_count_rate.unit: erg cm-2 s-1 per ct s-1
oh_flux_per_count_rate.source: OH (1-0) emission spectrum convolved with the OH-band throughput; flux in the (1-0) band only
